rationale: Cloud Computing ranks first because the EPA opportunity is explicitly centered on migrating legacy on-premise data warehouses to AWS GovCloud and operating within FISMA Moderate authorization boundaries, directly matching Cloud Migration & Change Management and Security, Operations & Management sub-services. Data & Analytics follows immediately given the core requirement for enterprise data governance frameworks, advanced analytics for regulatory decision-making, and IV&V of migrated datasets, aligning tightly with Enterprise Data Architecture and Governance and Advanced Data Analytics. IT & Engineering Services places third due to the DevSecOps pipeline establishment requirement and infrastructure architecture work, while Business Support Services edges ahead of Management Consulting because it contains Independent Verification and Validation and Systems Documentation & Training, both explicitly called out in the scope. Management Consulting, though relevant for IT strategy and regulatory compliance support, addresses more advisory functions that are secondary to the hands-on technical and data work driving this EPA modernization effort.
